Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.rail.lightning

Class LndRestLightningClient

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.rail.lightning.LndRestLightningClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
LightningChannelGateway, LightningClient, LightningInvoiceGateway, LightningPaymentGateway
@Component("kfeLndRestLightningClient") @Primary @ConditionalOnProperty(prefix="lightning.lnd.rest", name="enabled", havingValue="true") public class LndRestLightningClient extends Object implements LightningClient, LightningPaymentGateway, LightningInvoiceGateway, LightningChannelGateway
LND REST adapter: balance probe, pay invoice, create/lookup invoices, channels. Enabled only when lightning.lnd.rest.enabled=true. Marked Primary so channel lifecycle prefers this bean when invoice/payment gateway aliases also expose the same implementation type.

    • LndRestLightningClient

      public LndRestLightningClient(@Qualifier("lndRestTemplate") org.springframework.web.client.RestTemplate restTemplate, com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper objectMapper, @Value("${lightning.lnd.base-url}") String baseUrl, @Value("${lightning.lnd.macaroon}") String macaroonHex, @Value("${lightning.lnd.payment-timeout-seconds:30}") int paymentTimeoutSeconds, @Value("${lightning.lnd.invoice-expiry-seconds:3600}") int defaultInvoiceExpirySeconds, org.springframework.beans.factory.ObjectProvider<LnurlPayResolver> lnurlPayResolver)
      Creates the LND adapter and normalizes endpoint, credential, and invoice-expiry settings.
      Parameters:
      restTemplate - LND-specific HTTP client
      objectMapper - JSON serializer and parser
      baseUrl - LND REST base URL
      macaroonHex - LND macaroon in hexadecimal form
      paymentTimeoutSeconds - maximum router payment request duration
      defaultInvoiceExpirySeconds - fallback lifetime for invoices without an explicit expiry
      lnurlPayResolver - optional LNURL/Lightning Address resolver

    • prepareLightning

      public LightningPaymentGateway.PreparedLightningPayment prepareLightning(CustodyGateway.LightningPaymentCommand command)
      Resolves supported destination forms into a persisted payment identity before sending funds. BOLT11 hashes are decoded by LND; keysend preimages are generated once and returned encoded so retries can use the exact same payment identity.
      Specified by:
      prepareLightning in interface LightningPaymentGateway
      Parameters:
      command - requested payment and wallet context
      Returns:
      immutable prepared payment with normalized destination kind and payment hash
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when the command or destination syntax is invalid
      IllegalStateException - when required LNURL resolution or hash decoding fails

    • payPreparedLightning

      public CustodyGateway.PaymentResult payPreparedLightning(LightningPaymentGateway.PreparedLightningPayment prepared)
      Reconciles the persisted payment hash before submitting, then returns only a terminal success. Existing terminal failures are rejected; pending/unknown states and hash mismatches remain in-flight so the outbox can reconcile instead of releasing the user's reserve prematurely.
      Specified by:
      payPreparedLightning in interface LightningPaymentGateway
      Parameters:
      prepared - previously persisted payment identity and execution parameters
      Returns:
      normalized terminal-success payment result
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for invalid prepared data or a terminal provider failure
      LightningPaymentInFlightException - when provider state is nonterminal or mismatched

    • payInvoice

      public LndRestLightningClient.LightningPaymentResult payInvoice(String paymentRequest, long amountSats, long maxFeeSats)
      Pays a BOLT11 invoice through LND while enforcing fixed/amountless invoice amount rules. Fixed invoices reject a conflicting requested amount; amountless invoices require a positive explicit amount. Permanent provider failures are surfaced as non-retryable exceptions.
      Parameters:
      paymentRequest - BOLT11 invoice text
      amountSats - explicit amount for amountless invoices, or matching amount for fixed invoices
      maxFeeSats - maximum routing fee in satoshis
      Returns:
      payment hash, fee, provider status, and raw response
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for amount mismatch, missing amount, or permanent payment failure

      public static long parseBolt11AmountSatsFromHrp(String paymentRequest)
      Offline BOLT11 amount from human-readable part, e.g. lntb1m1... → 100_000 sats, lntb800u1... → 80_000, lnbc1p... (no amount) → 0.
